The '''N-s6 Navcon''' was the standard navigational computer for the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], and was manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]].
